text:
alexa: Heads-up - onboarding run for rerank-lite-v1 (FP16 -> PTQ int4) shows a focused degradation on very short queries (<6 tokens). MRR_all -0.018, MRR_tiny -0.030, NDCG@10_tiny -0.015. Not panic-yet but noticeable.
pat: can you paste the condensed slice/table?
alexa: sure, condensed: 

```
model         | MRR_all | MRR_tiny | NDCG10_all | NDCG10_tiny
-------------|---------|----------|------------|------------
fp16-baseline | 0.447   | 0.513    | 0.698      | 0.732
ptq-int4      | 0.429   | 0.483    | 0.689      | 0.717
delta         | -0.018  | -0.030   | -0.009     | -0.015
```

ren: interesting. Which eval set? tokenization/version? and did you keep same candidate ordering? tiny queries are sensitive to priming/order.
alexa: eval set = combined-search-2025 holdout (~40k). tokenizer commit = fb2a1c3, same across runs. candidate pool = top50 from bi-encoder, ordering preserved. input format: `Q:

D` (query first).
zach: have you checked embedding distribution shifts? int4 often compresses magnitude and shifts mean; that can flip tie-breakers for short queries where score gaps small.
alexa: I computed stats: mean embedding L2 for query vectors (tiny subset) dropped by ~0.06 compared to FP16. bench-bot scheduled a quick re-eval.
bench-bot: job 1742000045 queued (rerank-lite-v1 | PTQ int4 | seed=1234)
pat: run a few controlled ablations: (1) L2 normalize embeddings before dot prod, (2) apply per-dataset affine rescale (learn alpha on small calibration split), (3) swap concat order doc+query, (4) batch_size=1 deterministic scoring.
alexa: queued those four. also adding a run with tokenizer whitespace normalization (strip repeated spaces) and a run with final projection per-channel quant enabled.
ren: good. also check whether we serialize embeddings differently in PTQ scoring path (float->int conversions) - micro differences there can be huge for tiny queries.
zach: if normalization fixes it, we can bake a small repo-level calibration step post-quantize that fits a linear scale on a 1k sample. avoids per-model retraining.
alexa: agreed. i'll try both global affine and per-channel on proj if needed. will include seed + tokenizer hash + candidate sampler in the run artifact.
bench-bot: job 1742000110 started (set: ablations L2norm, affine, concat-flip, batch1, whitespace-fix, per-channel).
pat: timeline?
alexa: expect first ablations in ~30m, full per-channel in a couple hours.
bench-bot: job 1742000175 finished. quick checksum: query-embed mean shift = -0.082 (int4 vs fp16) on tiny queries; L2-normalize run recovered ~0.012 MRR on tiny slice, affine-rescale recovered ~0.020. concat-flip had mixed results (+0.005 in some cohorts).
ren: looks like embedding scale is main driver. long-term: consider exporting calibration artifacts with each PTQ recipe (alpha, beta) and unit tests in the eval harness to catch future regressions.
zach: agreed. also add a small golden set of 250 terse queries to our canary to catch this earlier.
alexa: will add the golden set + commit a tiny calibration step in the quant pipeline. creating a short doc with exact commands and hyperparams so infra can reproduce on dedicated nodes. tagging #eng-ml-diagnostics. :rocket:
pat: thx. please attach the run IDs and the exact docker image + model sha when you post the doc.
alexa: will do. closing loop once artifacts uploaded.
